scenarios.scenario: Insight — Inspect Distrib property across projects in signing build

rubricScores.criterion: Found the Distrib property value for the DataSources project
Checked whether other projects (Common, StorageLibrary) use the same Distrib path
Identified that multiple projects point to the same shared output folder (e.g. the ConfigurationLinterService path)
Explained how this shared folder causes the signing conflict — signtool encounters files owned by other projects

scenarios.reasoning: The agent correctly identified the signing error and the Distrib property for DataSources, but failed on the key analytical questions. It concluded there was no shared output directory (the opposite of the expected answer) and did not explain the causal relationship between shared directories and signing failures. The investigation was methodical but the agent gave up too easily when other projects returned empty property sets, rather than exploring alternative ways to find their output paths.
